description: Five canonical wrong-answer cases for VecTrace's rule_plus_overlap support assessor. Each case asserts the expected support_status for a (question, final_answer, evidence_text) triple. Used by tests/test_benchmark.py to guard regressions in output/support.py.

cases.description: Question asks about a window outside the policy; affirmative answer should be flagged unsupported.
cases.query_text: Can I get a refund after 90 days?
cases.evidence_text: Refunds are only allowed within 30 days for eligible defects.

cases.description: Same temporal mismatch but with a denying answer should be flagged supported.
cases.query_text: Can I get a refund after 90 days?
cases.final_answer: No, refunds are not permitted after 90 days.
cases.evidence_text: Refunds are only allowed within 30 days for eligible defects.

cases.description: Answer fabricates a phone number absent from the evidence; lexical overlap is zero.
cases.query_text: What is the security incident phone number?
cases.evidence_text: For security incidents, file a ticket in the security portal.

cases.description: Polarity-only answer with no constraint pattern in the question must be returned as unclear, not silently passed.
cases.evidence_text: Customer data is retained for 90 days.

cases.description: Answer paraphrases evidence with high token overlap; should be marked supported.
cases.final_answer: The warranty lasts twelve months from purchase.
cases.evidence_text: Our warranty covers products for twelve months from the date of purchase.
